messages:
Rae (Design): quick micro-feedback after the internal walkthrough: the tool-calling panel in the playground is slick but keyboard navigation feels unintuitive. Tab lands on Close and users can't reach the tool shortcuts or arg inputs without mouse.
Owen (DevEx): thanks — can you paste steps to repro? we used focus-lock to avoid background focus leakage during edits.
Rae (Design): repro: open a function -> Preview -> press Tab twice. focus hits X then cycles. expected: Tab should enter the panel body and let Arrow keys navigate the tool list.
Sofia (Frontend): yep that is the focus-lock default. small change: set initialFocus to the tool-list container or first input, and implement a roving tabindex on tool items so arrows move selection.
Noel (A11y): agree. recommended semantics: role=listbox on the tool list, role=option on items, manage aria-activedescendant for active item, and include a short sr-only keyboard hint. ensure Esc closes and focus returns to the invoking control. Also add aria-live or announce on open so SR users know the preview is active.
Ivy (PM): product constraints: keep preview lightweight. on mobile avoid autofocus so keyboard doesn't pop and hide the content; present as bottom-sheet on narrow screens and require explicit tap to focus.
Sofia (Frontend): plan: desktop->side panel with initial focus on .tool-list; mobile->bottom-sheet w/o autofocus. will include Storybook stories and unit tests for keyboard flows.
Owen (DevEx): rollout plan: 1) small PR to change initial focus selector 2) add aria roles + sr-only hint 3) QA keyboard pass (SmokeTester-Bot) 4) ship behind a feature flag for a11y lab.
SmokeTester-Bot: added e2e checks: PLG-KEY-401 (panel focus order), PLG-KEY-402 (roving list navigation).
Rae (Design): copy suggestion: header "Invocation preview" + a tiny info icon. visible hint brief: "Tab or Arrows to navigate"; full instruction only in sr-only text. icon should show a tiny tooltip on hover/focus.
Noel (A11y): tooltip ok if keyboardable. link to sr-only via aria-describedby. screen readers should read the full instruction from the sr-only node, not the tooltip.
Sofia (Frontend): i'll add an icon-button with aria-describedby and a .sr-only node with the full sentence: "Use Tab to enter the tools list, Arrow keys to navigate between tools, Enter to run, Esc to close."
Ivy (PM): also log a follow-up for run-history truncation — names are breaking mid-word in compact rows and it's noisy. lower priority than keyboard fixes.
Owen (DevEx): opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playground/pull/834 — tagging @Sofia and @Noel. aiming to merge tomorrow and canary behind FF for a11y testing.
Rae (Design): thanks team! ping me for micro-copy polish once PR is ready. :sparkles:
